# SelfOrganizedRobustness

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Emergent resilience in mean-field interacting systems arising from self-organizing dynamics without external control. Provides a theoretical basis for building fault-tolerant TCC/iNEST systems that maintain function under perturbation.
